title: PolyNite
tagline: Drop a model. Explore every detail.
description: A WebGPU-powered GLB viewer with Nanite-like adaptive geometry. Drop a 3D model and explore it instantly with dynamic lighting, environments, animations and real-time LOD.
short: A WebGPU GLB viewer with Nanite-like adaptive geometry.

features.title: Drag & drop GLB
features.text: Drop a .glb or .gltf anywhere on the page. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Adaptive geometry
features.text: Nanite-like cluster LOD keeps dense meshes fast without losing detail.

features.title: WebGPU rendering
features.text: Modern GPU pipeline running natively in the browser.

features.title: Dynamic lighting
features.text: Real-time lights, environments, reflections and materials.

features.title: Animation playback
features.text: Skinned and rigged GLB animations play straight from the file.

features.title: Desktop and mobile
features.text: One viewer, adapting to the device it runs on.

slides.title: PolyNite
slides.text: Drop a model. Explore every detail — right in your browser.

slides.title: It sees clusters
slides.text: PolyNite breaks every mesh into thousands of small clusters. Each frame, the engine keeps only the clusters — and the level of detail — the camera actually needs.

slides.title: You see the model
slides.text: None of that work is visible. What reaches the screen is the full model — lit, shaded and animated in real time.

slides.title: Drag. Drop. Done.
slides.text: A WebGPU pipeline, no install, no upload. Drop a .glb or .gltf on the page and it opens instantly — desktop and mobile.

slides.title: Made for the new 3D
slides.text: High-density scans, sculpts and AI-generated assets render without melting the page.
